items.proposed: Agreed coding stands provisionally: has_eligible_candidate true (APG-157 candidate), pending the D30-R5 licensing check
items.reason: The record registers APG-157 as '[DRUG] APG-157' given as 'pastilles' with efficacy endpoints and blood PK of 'APG-157 components', but never states what it is. If APG-157 is a botanical (e.g. curcumin-type) product, D30-R5 makes it a candidate only if licensed as a medicine; the record alone cannot settle this.

items.proposed: experimental_monotherapy, provisional (excluded_intervention_type if it is an unlicensed botanical under D30-R5)
items.reason: APG-157 is the only investigational agent on continued standard-of-care bevacizumab ('continue to receive Bevacizumab as standard of care'), so rule 4 applies if it is a medicine; its product type and licensing status are not in the record ('APG-157 components' suggests a multi-component product).

note: D31 §D evidence check pending: APG-157 is on the unidentified-agents list, so the proposal stays as drafted until XL identifies it (and, if a botanical, records its licensing status for D30-R5 / Table S2). If unlicensed botanical: has_eligible_candidate false, candidate_exclusion_reason excluded_intervention_type, regimen not_applicable. Bevacizumab is continued standard of care (soc_backbone).
